```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Root locator: knitr renders with cwd set to the vignettes directory.
.pkg_root <- function() {
  for (dd in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(dd, "DESCRIPTION"))) return(normalizePath(dd))
  }
  NA_character_
}
PKG <- .pkg_root()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

msuiter's application-scenario drivers (`bench/scenarios/run_atlas.R`,
`run_hrd.R`, `run_treatment.R`) persist their evidence tables under
`bench/scenarios/out/`. This page galleries every committed witness there:
one card per file, each carrying an in-process sha256 provenance stamp, a
row/column census and a verbatim excerpt of the leading data rows. No
number on this page is hand-typed: `tools/scenarios-gallery.R` re-derives
every digit from the committed bytes at build time, and the testthat law
`tests/testthat/test-scenarios-gallery.R` audits that every card names its
witness and that every stamp and census matches the disk bytes -- a
tampered witness, a dropped card or an empty witness tree reddens the lane.

```{r gallery, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (is.na(PKG) ||
    !dir.exists(file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out")) ||
    !file.exists(file.path(PKG, "tools", "scenarios-gallery.R"))) {
  cat("rendered outside the committed data tree: this page prints no number here;\nre-derive the gallery with `Rscript tools/scenarios-gallery.R --out=<dir>` from the repository root\n")
} else {
  Sys.setenv(MSUITER_TOOL_NO_MAIN = "1")
  source(file.path(PKG, "tools", "scenarios-gallery.R"), local = TRUE)
  cat(paste0(c("<div class=\"scenarios-gallery\">", scg_render(PKG), "</div>"),
             collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n")
  Sys.unsetenv("MSUITER_TOOL_NO_MAIN")
}
```

Every stamp above is recomputed from the file bytes the moment this page
builds; to re-derive the census yourself, run
`Rscript tools/scenarios-gallery.R --out=<dir>` from the repository root and
diff its `manifest.tsv` against what you see here.
